dialogue.text: AI didn't replace the work. It changed what the work IS.

beats.text: Before AI, making this video would require an animation team and six weeks. With AI, it takes one person and eleven hours. But that one person needs to be a director, not an operator. The skill shifted from "how to make it" to "what to make and is it good enough."
